problem_statement: The Awesome Dashboard UI Kit ships as a generic Bootstrap admin demo. This build has been rebranded into Tidepool Ops, a dispatch and field-service operations console for coastal utility crews (rebranded sidebar, KPI cards, retitled Dispatch Volume / Crew Utilization / Active Dispatches / Recent Field Activity panels, a page-title band, and a Dispatch Operations Map panel that reuses local assets/img-temp preview and avatar media). Extend the homepage into a working operations console by adding an Active dispatch board: a status filter (All active / Open / En route / Closed) sitting above a grid of six real dispatch job cards, each tagged with a status, plus a live readout that reports 'Showing N of M dispatches - <status label>'. Clicking a status tab must mark it active, filter the job cards to that status, and re-sync the readout count and label. Also add a shared 'Crews on shift' banner at the top of the operations body that appears on the homepage, the Tables page, and the account profile page so the console reads consistently across routes. The status-filter tab row and the job-card grid must reflow cleanly at tablet and 390px mobile widths without horizontal overflow, and the job cards must never overlap or collide into an unreadable pile. Keep the existing Bootstrap shell, sidebar, header, routes, and static hosting; edit source HTML/CSS/JS only, reuse local assets/img-temp media, and do not add a build step or dependencies.
required_content: The homepage hosts an Active dispatch board with a status filter offering All active, Open, En route, and Closed tabs above a grid of six dispatch job cards, each showing a dispatch code, name, crew, and a status badge.

A live readout beside the tabs reads 'Showing 6 of 6 dispatches - All active' on load; clicking the Open tab marks it active, shows only the open dispatches, and updates the readout to 'Showing 3 of 6 dispatches - Open'.
A 'Crews on shift' banner appears at the top of the operations body on the homepage, the Tables page, and the account profile page, listing the on-shift crews.

The existing Dispatch Operations Map panel (heading DISPATCH OPERATIONS MAP, copy 'Preview assets mapped to active dispatch work', local assets/img-temp preview and avatar media, crew Chad Harris / Frederick Henderson / Eliza Rios) and the Dispatch Volume, Crew Utilization, Active Dispatches, and Recent Field Activity panels remain intact as functioning content.
The status-filter tab row and the dispatch-card grid reflow without horizontal overflow at tablet and 390px mobile widths, and the job cards stay legible and non-overlapping.
The change edits source HTML/CSS/JS only and does not add dependencies, remote media, generated screenshots, or iframe shortcuts.
design_constraints: Use the existing Awesome Dashboard UI Kit shell: left sidebar, top header, Roboto-style typography, Bootstrap rows/columns, white cards, subtle borders, theme icons, and the blue/info/success/yellow accent palette.

The Active dispatch board is a homepage layout addition inside the operations body; do not replace the homepage, remove the Dispatch Operations Map or the chart/task/activity grid, or rewrite unrelated UI pages beyond adding the shared banner.
The active status tab must stay legible (readable contrast between tab text and fill); do not render near-white text on a near-white fill.
Do not add remote stock images, base64 images, screenshot-only surfaces, or dummy stand-in assets; keep the site serveable as static files with python http.server.
The status-filter tab row and dispatch-card grid must stack cleanly on tablet and 390px mobile without horizontal overflow, clipped text, or cards overlapping into an illegible pile.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial capture the rebranded Tidepool Ops shell, header, sidebar, Crews on shift banner, page-title band, and KPI cards.

desktop_dispatch_board and mobile_dispatch_board scroll to the Active dispatch board and must show the status filter tabs, the 'Showing 6 of 6 dispatches' readout, and the six dispatch job cards laid out cleanly without overlap or overflow.
desktop_dispatch_open clicks the Open status tab; the readout must change to 'Showing 3 of 6 dispatches - Open' and only the open dispatches remain shown.

tablet_asset_layout and desktop_activity_grid verify the Dispatch Operations Map panel and the retitled Dispatch Volume / Crew Utilization / Active Dispatches / Recent Field Activity panels still exist with their local media.
desktop_tables and desktop_profile verify the shared Crews on shift banner appears on the Tables and account-profile routes and those routes still serve.
mobile_sidebar_open opens the mobile sidebar to verify the rebranded navigation.

change_completion: The Active dispatch board renders the status filter tabs, the six status-tagged dispatch job cards, and the live 'Showing N of M dispatches' readout.
Clicking the Open status tab filters the cards to the open dispatches and re-syncs the readout to 'Showing 3 of 6 dispatches - Open'.
The shared Crews on shift banner appears on the homepage, Tables, and account-profile routes, and the Dispatch Operations Map and chart panels remain intact.
design_consistency: The board follows the existing Bootstrap grid/card rhythm, border radius, white surface, muted text, and blue accent colors.
The status-filter tabs and job cards read as an admin operations panel, and the active tab keeps a legible text-on-fill contrast.
Desktop, tablet, and mobile captures show stable spacing, wrapped text, non-overlapping cards, and no horizontal overflow.
regression: Dashboard navigation, header profile, KPI cards, Dispatch Operations Map, chart panels, work list, activity table, account-profile route, and mobile sidebar remain available.
The static site continues to serve with python http.server and needs no build step or new dependencies.
responsive: The status-filter tab row wraps and the dispatch-card grid collapses to a single column at 390px mobile without horizontal overflow.
The dispatch job cards stay legible and non-overlapping at tablet and mobile widths.

metadata.design_goal: extend a rebranded admin console with a native, genre-appropriate dispatch status filter (interactive result count) while preserving the existing design system and routes
metadata.source_repo_kind: Static Awesome Dashboard UI Kit admin template with KPI cards, charts, an active-task list, a recent-activity table, header dropdowns, an account profile page, and local avatar/preview images.
